name: Stage1b observable-target Oracle diagnosis and pretrained visual-feature control
data: reuse immutable Stage1a RGB/geometry/focus/K/split, no new scenes; gen08..11 previously seen, descriptive recheck not independent test

observable_target.inputs: only quantized input RGB and GT signed CoC; no raw foreground/hidden background/alpha read by target function
observable_target.construction: linear-light Gaussian bank radii0..11, sigma=radius/2, radius0 identity, reflect101; per-pixel interpolate adjacent integer radii according to abs(CoC), convert sRGB and store float16
observable_target.meaning: input-determined spatial gather blur, NOT physical bokeh GT or an occlusion model

models.shared_trunk: unchanged Stage1a VideoGenerationProbe,395651 parameters, same seed initialization
models.strong: 2->128->224->128->32 Conv1x1 SiLU layers + same FocusInteraction[feature,query,difference,product]128->32 SiLU;66336 parameters
models.Tokens: same frozen VGGT stage1a features and same69696 parameter adapter, old checkpoint reused for ray target
models.DINO: official independent DINOv2 ViT-L/14 reg4 weights; current-frame1024 + fixed5-frame same-position mean1024; same input resize518x294, grid21x37, same projection/normalization/FocusInteraction/trunk/seed/budget as VGGT
models.OracleLog: original centered log-depth and log focal ratio clip[-4,4]/4
models.OracleCoC: [signedCoC,absCoC] /10.6666667 from known GT geometry; includes K, amplitude change disclosed
models.DepthStrong: predicted VGGT centered log-depth and log focal ratio; NOT claimed metric CoC, no test-GT scale fitting

conditional_policy: Run five observable arms; full ray numeric-adapter block only if either CoC arm gains>=1dB over identity on BOTH train and legacy-dev source means. Regardless of that gate, run DINO ray arm for independently meaningful visual-feature comparison. No automatic extra optimization on failure.

train.checkpoint: fixed final2000; no dev selection or retries for weak scores

evaluation.primary: source-equal mean of per-frame/focus/K PSNR,12px border excluded, same Stage1a metrics
evaluation.diagnostic_gate: >=1dB OracleCoC over Identity in train AND legacy-dev; legacy-test reported separately, not used for gate
evaluation.ray_gate: VGGT-DINO PSNR>=0.3dB and boundary MAE no more than2percent worse; report both legacy source splits and each scene; NOT proof geometry alone caused gain
evaluation.strong_numeric_factor: log vs CoC paired at same adapter, small vs strong paired at same representation; strong bundles capacity and FocusInteraction, not a pure interaction ablation
limitations: all four evaluation sources already seen
two-plane reference has fixed2m/6m geometry and limited focus coverage
DINO and VGGT differ in feature stage, training and frame interaction; matching adapter does not match backbones
observable target lacks occlusion optics; passing does not prove real bokeh
no Stage2/full diffusion/ATB/3DGS training, no benchmark modification

artifacts: design/config/code + results/training/cost/verification JSON/CSV + representative25-frame videos; user judges visual quality
